articles.teaser: In Istanbul hat der Hauptprozess gegen den Oppositionspolitiker Ekrem İmamoğlu begonnen. Dem Gegner des türkischen Präsidenten Erdoğan drohen mehr als 2.000 Jahre Haft.
articles.image_title: Türkei: ISTANBUL, TURKEY - MARCH 09: Supporters of Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu protest outside Silivri Marmara Prison and Courthouse Complex during his first hearing over accusations leveled against him on March 09, 2026 in Istanbul, Turkey. The main trial of Istanbul Mayor Ekrem Imamoglu and 407 other defendants began at the courthouse complex in Silivri, in Istanbul, Turkey. Prosecutors are seeking a combined sentence of 2,430 years in prison for Imamoglu, accusing him of leading a criminal network linked to alleged corruption within the Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality. Imamoglu, a senior figure in the opposition Republican People's Party (CHP), has been held at Marmara Prison in Silivri since his arrest in March 2025. Imamoglu emerged as the most prominent challenger to current President Recep Tayyip Erdogan before his arrest. Critics say his detention marked a broader crackdown on the CHP. (Photo by Burak Kara/Getty Images)
